doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Coconut Grove nightclub advertisement
summary: Allen reads a Coconut Grove ad at 300 Burgundy Street; they date it around 1947 and Allen gives the date of the interview.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

No, one starts at 9.15, then 10.30 p.m., then 12.15 a.m., 2.30 a.m. Jam session every Sunday morning, 4 a.m. That's as interesting as well.
Oh, it's 10.11 p.m. to the day. Yeah, 10.11 p.m.
